d: Prominent northern zodiacal constellation crowned by the twin stars Pollux and sextuple-system Castor.

hip-37826.x: Brightest star in Gemini (34 ly), an orange giant orbited by confirmed extrasolar giant planet Thestias.

hip-36850.x: Fascinating multiple star system (51 ly) consisting of three visual pairs, each of which is a spectroscopic binary.

hip-31681.x: Luminous white subgiant star marking the southern foot of the twin Pollux.

hip-30343.x: Slow irregular pulsating red giant star marking the foot of the twin Castor.

gaia-866177431955478144.x: Subgiant multiple star system situated very close to the ecliptic plane.
